summary: The candidate proves and fixes the ordinary current-main delayed final-prefill abort token race, but an independent beam-group final-prefill cancellation still enters beam commit before the abort-drop branch. The original negative scheduler output-id symptom and HTTP/model workload were not reproduced in the available ROCm environment.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a8f7916eaf5a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q <externally archived candidate test_scheduler_chunked_req_gate.py> <externally archived candidate test_batch_result_processor_hidden_states.py>
tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base failing-before: 3 failed, 11 passed, 2 subtests passed. The failures showed cancelled-prefill optimistic-decode admission, output_ids [101], and sampling-mask finish precedence over the pending abort.
Exact candidate commit regression and adjacent scheduler/result compatibility coverage: 22 passed, 2 subtests passed.
Independent counterexample: an aborted final-prefill beam request called beam_coordinator.commit_prefill(req, up_to_tick=7), bypassing the candidate's later drop_prefill_result branch.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a8f7916eaf5a/venv/bin/python -c '<print scheduler/result processor __file__, Torch/HIP version, device and ISA>'
tests.what_was_measured: Imports resolved to /job/repo/python sources. Environment reported Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned gfx950 GPU was enumerated through the prepared Torch/ROCm interpreter. Issue-specific model execution was not performed; the regressions are scheduler/result control-flow tests.

remaining_counterexamples: A cancelled final-prefill request with beam_group set still invokes beam_coordinator.commit_prefill before the candidate's drop_prefill_result branch.
No candidate regression measures or rules out negative scheduler output_ids in the reported serving workload.
remaining_limitations: The reported meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct weights were unavailable, so the original HTTP workload was not rerun.
The available GPU was AMD gfx950 rather than NVIDIA RTX 4090/CUDA; no CUDA-specific claim is made.
The issue-specific tests did not execute a model on GPU.
Current main no longer has the old scheduler batch representation described by the report, leaving the negative output-id symptom unverified rather than disproved.
No multi-rank, pipeline-parallel, or disaggregated runtime validation was performed.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
